issue.title: Copy chips: click-to-copy text authored in Obsidian notes
issue.description: Typing an inline code span that starts with `copy:` (or a `bob-copy` fence) gives a quiet, theme-native chip that copies exactly the authored text with one click or one key, in every Obsidian view. Mod+Shift+Y makes or edits a chip without hand-escaping. The GTD agent prompts in gtd_daily.md are the first chips.

payload.entry: LANDING TRIAGE (bob-cli-ni.land): Verified ni.1, ni.2, ni.3, ni.5, ni.6 against plan:202611/copy_chips.md (api.copyChips v1 frozen and never-throwing; copy-on-cursor-line and make-or-edit with Mod+Shift+Y; q types only in the author fields; bob-copy-chips 0.4.0 synced and enabled; chezmoi allowlist, vault .gitignore, and community-plugins entries; six gtd_daily.md chips plus the gy nnoremap in bc60835f3; glossary:copy-chip matches the shipped behavior; no epic-symbol entries). Remaining epic work is in ni.4 (0a4a91f), which drifted from the plan's copycard phase: the row always shows, even with no chip or the plugin absent; it sits in the file group, not a chip group after TASK; its label is 'Copy chip', not 'Chip · <face>'; it bypasses copyCardRow and suppresses the card Notice instead of copying and then calling flash; it requires version===1 and copyChip; no manifest bump; no e2e; docs/copy-card.md untouched; and the scripts/test-navigation-copy-card-model.cjs:547 row-order test is stale. That fix goes to a lander tale. Follow-up outcomes: (1) the ni.5 #1 stale test, the epic note #1 DISCOVERED ISSUE from ms.8, and the ni.6 #5 copy-card docs gap were caused by this epic, so they are folded into the tale; no task. (2) The ni.5 #2 ledger-tools 25 ms perf flakes reproduced in the landing npm test and passed in isolation; they are duplicates, +1'd on bob-cli-km (event-link-times) and bob-cli-io (frees-marks). (3) The ni.6 #2 research phase 3 (snippet picker, masked copy*, rich-text copy, per-note opt-out) was filed as bob-cli-nm (feature, large, ready). (4) The ni.6 #3 plain-text surfaces showing raw chip source was filed as bob-cli-nn (feature, large, ready, related to nm). (5) The ni.6 #4 bob-emoji tracked in vault git is a duplicate of bob-cli-cd (already reopened by a bob-emoji +1) and was +1'd with a fresh 2026-11-19 reproduction. (6) The ni.1 collision census found no user-facing hit, so no follow-up.

Land copy-chip C row per plan:202611/copy_card_chip_row_land.md. Landing verification ni.1-ni.6 per LANDING TRIAGE note on bob-cli-ni (api.copyChips v1 frozen never-throwing, copy-on-cursor-line and make-or-edit Mod+Shift+Y, vault adoption, glossary:copy-chip accurate, no epic-symbols). C-row fixes in bob-plugins: builtin id copy-chip to chip label Chip, buildCopyCardChipRow returns null unless ready non-whitespace or ambiguous (ready group chip value byte-exact, label Chip-Face truncated 40 with ⏎, preview ⏎; ambiguous dimmed 2-chips reason), model appends chip last after TASK, feature-detect version>=1 and chipAt, resolveCopyCardChip returns null for absent/multi/invalid/throw/none and passes ready/ambiguous, copyCardRow copies value via clipboard then flash with throw-safe, modal CHIP divider is-chip with TASK probe on :not(.is-chip), manifest 2.89.0 to 2.90.0. Tests: model 59 pass, view 22 pass (chip last, ready/ambiguous/no-row/collision/default cases); build and build:check pass; validate passes; docs inventory regenerated; npm test 7497/7502 with only known km event-link-times and io frees-marks failing under load, both pass in isolation (23/23, 17/17), perf 8/8; e2e extended (chip fixture, probe fix, 7 chip cases) self-test passes offline, real Obsidian e2e not run on apollo (no Obsidian/xvfb-run) and not run on athena this turn; docs copy-card and bob-copy-chips updated per plan; sync deployed 2.90.0 to vault (list shows HEAD 2.89.0 drift until host commits). Follow-ups: nm and nn created, km/io/cd corroborated, stale row-order test and copy-card docs folded, no new beads.
